items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So I got to go on the road with Ben Pollack's band and orchestra

ctx.x: And I did want to go to the University of Chicago. My mother wanted me to be a doctor and I felt like I would like to study medicine also and interested in it. However, I really, when I got playing with the bands and got around is when I

really realised that the lack of education and I wanted to learn. So I got to go on the road with Ben Pollack's band and orchestra which at that time consisted of Benny Goodman, Glen Miller was also in the band, the Pollack band. And we'd do some one nighters and go around and get up the next day and nothing to do. I thought to myself I ought to go to school.

So it developed I went to this one school in Ohio and I can't remember what school it was. It might have been Ohio University, I don't know. But there was always a college around. And I would go to the dean of the school. Tell him just what I was doing that I had just started my third year in highschool and that I thought I sadly was sadly neglecting my education and I wanted to learn.
